description: One aisle wide and stacked to the ceiling on both sides: tins with the labels sun-bleached off, sacks of grey rice, batteries in blister packs, a rack of cigarettes behind wire. The counter is a chest freezer with a board across it. A hand-written card taped to the till reads TAB AVAILABLE — ASK — DON'T ASK TWICE. Half the street's names are on the list behind it.
name: Bodega Vu — Shop
